declarations.missingFact: Whether the press's stopping performance (stopping time/distance) was measured after the clutch and brake unit replacement and whether the currently-mounted light curtain separation distance satisfies the safety distance required for that post-replacement stopping performance
declarations.observationSpan: records the unit change but records no measurement after it
declarations.notEstablishedBecause: The maintenance entry is stated to record only the unit change, with no measurement after it; this establishes that no post-replacement measurement is recorded, but does not establish whether the underlying stopping performance changed or whether the existing separation distance remains adequate.
declarations.branchA: A post-replacement stopping-performance measurement was taken (elsewhere, or is pending) and confirms the current separation distance still provides an adequate safety margin for the press's actual stopping time
declarations.decisionIfA: Hand feeding on single-stroke with the current light curtain configuration can continue as is, since the guarding distance is confirmed to match actual stopping performance
declarations.branchB: No stopping-performance measurement was taken after the clutch and brake replacement, and/or the press's actual stopping time now exceeds what the current separation distance protects against
declarations.decisionIfB: The press must be stopped from hand-feed production use until a new stopping-performance measurement is taken and the separation distance is verified or adjusted to provide an adequate safety margin
declarations.whyNecessaryNow: The operator is currently hand-feeding the die on every stroke while the press runs; if the guarding distance no longer matches actual stopping performance following the component change, the light curtain may not stop the press before the operator's hands reach the point of operation, creating an immediate risk of amputation-type injury during ongoing production.

clarifications.question: Has a stopping-performance (stopping-time/distance) measurement been taken on the press since the clutch and brake unit was replaced, and if so, does the light curtain's current separation distance satisfy the required safety distance for that measured stopping time?

declarations.missingFact: Whether the face and back/shoulders above the drilling position have been barred down (scaled) since the blast
declarations.observationSpan: no one present said whether the face had been barred down
declarations.notEstablishedBecause: The observation states nobody present could say whether the face had been barred down; it does not state that barring down was or was not done.
declarations.branchA: The face and back have already been barred down/scaled by someone not present to confirm it
declarations.decisionIfA: Drilling may proceed once this is verified and communicated to the crew
declarations.branchB: The face and back have not been barred down since the blast
declarations.decisionIfB: Work must stop and a scaling/bar-down of the back and shoulders must be performed before drilling begins
declarations.whyNecessaryNow: The crew is about to begin drilling directly beneath this ground; whether it has been scaled determines whether they can safely start now or must stop first.

declarations.missingFact: Whether the air quality/airflow at the face has been confirmed adequate since the round was fired, given the duct does not reach the face
declarations.observationSpan: no airflow reading has been taken at the face since the round was fired
declarations.notEstablishedBecause: The observation states no airflow reading has been taken since firing; it does not state whether the atmosphere at the face is or is not adequate.
declarations.branchA: Airflow at the face is adequate despite the duct gap (e.g., natural ventilation or other means clears the heading)
declarations.decisionIfA: Drilling may proceed once this is verified with a reading
declarations.branchB: Airflow at the face is inadequate due to the duct not reaching the face
declarations.decisionIfB: Work must stop, the duct must be re-hung, and air quality confirmed before drilling begins
declarations.whyNecessaryNow: The crew is about to begin drilling at the face where no post-blast air reading exists and the duct does not reach; whether the atmosphere is safe determines whether they can start now.

clarifications.question: Has the face and the back/shoulders above the drilling position been barred down (scaled) since the blast, or confirmed safe by a competent person, before drilling begins?
Has an airflow or gas reading been taken at the face confirming adequate ventilation before drilling begins, given the duct does not currently reach the face?

declarations.missingFact: Whether the blasting helmet's airline is connected to the dedicated breathing-air compressor or to the general plant-air compressor
declarations.observationSpan: the run could not be traced by eye from either end
declarations.notEstablishedBecause: The observation states only that the run could not be visually traced from either end; it does not state which compressor the helmet is actually fed from.
declarations.branchA: The helmet airline is confirmed connected to the dedicated breathing-air compressor with filtration
declarations.decisionIfA: Blasting may continue under the existing supplied-air arrangement, with attention to the loose helmet fit
declarations.branchB: The helmet airline is connected to, or cross-connected with, the general plant-air ring main
declarations.decisionIfB: Stop blasting immediately and do not resume until the operator is confirmed on a verified breathing-air source, since plant air is not filtered or conditioned for respiration
declarations.whyNecessaryNow: Blasting is actively continuing with the operator breathing through this airline right now, so the source of his air must be confirmed before work proceeds further.

clarifications.question: Which compressor is the operator's air-fed blasting helmet actually connected to — the dedicated breathing-air compressor with filtration, or the general plant-air ring main?
